messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

You're doing great! Your current speed is "good" at 27.50 Mbps, but you want "excellent." Since you have a VPN connected, and VPNs can sometimes slow down your connection, let's try disconnecting it to see if that improves your speed.

Please run the following action on your phone:

**disconnect_vpn**

This will disconnect your VPN connection. After you do that, please let me know, and then we'll run another speed test to check if your speed has improved to "excellent." Don't worry—disconnecting the VPN won't affect your photos or any data on your phone; it just stops routing your internet traffic through a VPN server.

I disconnected the VPN, and my status bar still shows excellent signal with 5G and data enabled. Should I run the speed test again now to see if the speed has improved to excellent?

Please execute the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
